jobs.title: BACKEND DEVELOPER
Full Stack Java Developer
jobs.description:
Project description
VR-124185
Our Client is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Their purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.
Team is seeking a highly technical, hands-on Java developer. Our group is focused on bringing a new level of efficiency, transparency and openness to the trading process by building a collaborative community of investors, brokers, technology firms and content providers.
Through our modular, end-to-end trade management platform, users can: execute everything from simple single stock trades to complex strategies across markets and time zones and manage their risk throughout the trade lifecycle; access our growing network of execution brokers to route Equities, Futures or Options orders globally, as well as dozens of integrated prime and clearing brokers through our growing suite of middle office tools; and collaborate with our broker and vendor partners, who are able to efficiently plug into our platform to reach our community.
This role involves maintenance and enhancement of existing backend and web-based applications, and contributing to the evolution of our trading platform and web user interfaces.
Responsibilities
Contributes to design, development, and implementation of backend services and web applications.
Writes clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following established engineering practices.
Participates in technical design discussions and collaborates with senior engineers and architects.
Works closely with frontend developers to integrate backend services with UI components.
Supports troubleshooting, debugging, and performance optimization of applications.
Breaks down user stories into technical tasks and delivers within agreed timelines.
Collaborates effectively in Agile teams with product owners, QA, and other developers.
Maintains and improves existing systems while ensuring stability and reliability.
Builds positive relationships within the team and contributes to a collaborative environment.
Communicates technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Continuously develops technical expertise and stays up to date with modern technologies and frameworks.
Skills
Must have
Strong Java fundamentals (Java 21 preferred) including core concepts (collections, concurrency, memory management).
Solid experience with Spring Framework (Spring 4+) and Spring Boot 3.x.
Experience building and consuming REST APIs.
Good knowledge of React (version 17) and integration with backend services.
Strong understanding of web application architecture and client-server communication.
Experience with SQL and relational databases (e.g. PostgreSQL).
Proficiency with version control (Git) and build tools (Maven/Gradle).
Strong focus on clean code, unit testing, and code reviews.
Familiar with Agile development practices.
Comfortable working in Linux/Unix environments.
5-8+ years of software engineering experience.
Experience with trading platforms is preferred; however, candidates with broader financial services systems experience will also be considered.
Nice to have
Experience with JSF / JSP applications and legacy UI technologies.
Familiarity with modern frontend practices and component-based architectures.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and testing practices.
Exposure to Docker / containerization.
Basic understanding of distributed systems.
Familiarity with Spring ecosystem tooling.
Knowledge of financial systems or trading platforms is a plus.
BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent software engineering qualification.

jobs.title: IT Solutions Architect (Java)
jobs.description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.
Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.
JobCode: XYZ4512
Job Description
We are looking for an experienced
IT Solutions Architect
to join a major enterprise transformation programme within a highly regulated environment. This is a hands-on role combining solution architecture, software engineering expertise, and technical leadership.
Working closely with the core product team in Dresden, Germany as well as business stakeholders, and distributed delivery teams across Europe and the UK, you will be responsible for
designing, evolving, and modernising enterprise-scale platforms
while ensuring high performance standards, scalability, and maintainability.
Key Responsibilities
Define and drive solution architecture
for enterprise applications
Lead technical design activities
and support implementation across distributed teams
Contribute to the modernisation and evolution of complex legacy systems
Ensure solutions are
scalable, maintainable, secure and high performing
Collaborate closely with developers, architects, QA, DevOps and business stakeholders
Support delivery throughout the
full software development lifecycle
Promote
engineering best practice and architectural standards
across teams
Qualifications
We are looking for a technology leader with
10+ years' experience
in enterprise software development and solution architecture.
The ideal candidate will bring a
strong Java background
, including
Java 11/17
and
Java EE / Jakarta EE
, together with proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale applications. Strong
database design and development expertise
, particularly with
PostgreSQL
, is essential, as is hands-on experience with
Eclipse RCP, SWT and JFace
, and
WildFly Application Server
.
You should have a solid understanding of software architecture, object-oriented design principles and design patterns, with experience leading the modernisation of legacy systems and supporting long-term technology roadmaps. Experience with JPA/Hibernate, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Maven and Azure DevOps would be advantageous.
To succeed in this role, you will be a collaborative communicator who is comfortable working with geographically distributed teams and engaging effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Key Skills
10+ years' experience in enterprise software development and architecture
Strong Java background (Java 11/17, Java EE / Jakarta EE)
Database design and development expertise (PostgreSQL)
Eclipse RCP, SWT and JFace
WildFly Application Server
Enterprise software architecture and solution design
Legacy system modernisation
Object-oriented design, design patterns and engineering best practices
Experience working within complex enterprise environments
Why Join Us?
This is an opportunity to influence the technical direction of a significant enterprise programme while remaining close to the technology. You will work alongside experienced international teams, contribute to the evolution of business-critical platforms and play a key role in shaping future architecture decisions.
We are committed to creating an
inclusive and diverse workplace
where everyone is valued, respected and empowered to succeed. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences and believe that diverse perspectives make stronger teams and better solutions.
Travel:
Initial onboarding will take place in
Dresden
and will require a
2–3 week stay on-site
. Following onboarding, business travel to Dresden is expected approximately
once per quarter
.
Standard benefits for Permanent Employees in Romania:
13 monthly salaries per year (range 22.000 - 24.000 RON net / month)
Meal Vouchers
Gym Reimbursement
Medical Subscription
Health Insurance
25 days of annual leave + 1 extra day off for your birthday
Additional holidays for your loyalty
Additional Information
We support your development!
Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.
We embrace diversity!
As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Eurofins network of companies believes in strength and innovation through diversity. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.
Sustainability matters to us!
We are well on our way to achieving our objective of carbon neutrality by 2025, through a combination of emission reduction and compensation initiatives. We encourage our laboratory leaders to make sustainable changes at their local level, and in addition to their initiatives we count on our dedicated carbon reduction team to help us to achieve this goal!
Find out more on our Careers page: https://careers.eurofins.com/
Company description
: Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.
The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.
In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to ca. 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 60 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.
In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.95 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.
